description: Hand Hygiene: Wash hands before interacting with the patient
Identify Patient: Verify two identifiers (e.g name and date of birth)
Environment: Ensure privacy adjust room temperature and check for safety or precautions.
General Survey: Assess the patient's level of consciousness mood nutritional status and physical signs of distress.
Check for symmetry and normative ranges.Heart Rate (HR): Count beats per minute (usually 60–100 bpm) and note the rhythm. Respiratory Rate (RR) & Oxygen Saturation (SpO₂)
Record rate depth and effort of breathing.
Temperature: Record in Celsius or Fahrenheit.
